narr: Heavy rainfall occurred during the late evening hours of the 11th to the early morning hours of the 12th. Two to three inches of rain fell over Schoharie County. The rainfall along with debris blocking a culvert along Gorge Creek resulted in flash flooding in the village of Middleburgh. Several streets were flooded, and work crews had to pump out 15-20 cellars.
ev: Pleasant Valley Road was closed due to mud and debris left behind by flash flooding.
Flowing water and debris was reported across County Route 36 or Clauverwie Road in Middleburgh.

Gorge Creek overflowed its banks due to debris blocking a culvert, which sent water flowing across Main Street at Wells Avenue. There was water and electrical damage at the Middleburgh High School. Strub Lane was also filled with mud and debris. In addition, basement flooding was also occurring within the village.
